title: TypeScript Schema Compiler
description: Formal compiler for Zod schemas: the shared contract between UI and API. Verifies type safety, OpenAPI compatibility, and cross-compiler alignment.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract schema spec: entity name, fields with types/constraints, relationships, variants, validation rules

pipeline.title: Scaffold
pipeline.description: Generate schema.ts, types.ts, and openapi-schema.json stubs with correct structure

pipeline.title: Implement
pipeline.description: Write full Zod schemas with constraints, refinements, transforms, and discriminated unions

pipeline.title: Coverage Check
pipeline.description: Verify schema is complete enough to serve as source of truth: all fields have types, no placeholder fields

pipeline.title: Verify
pipeline.description: Validate OpenAPI compatibility, no circular dependencies, contract compliance

pipeline.title: Attest
pipeline.description: Produce signed schema-artifact.json with full field registry

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: schema-spec.json exists with required fields: entity, fields[], relationships[]

gates.title: Zod Valid
gates.description: schema.ts imports from 'zod', exports named schemas, balanced syntax

gates.title: No Any
gates.description: No TypeScript 'any', no z.any(), no z.unknown() without justification comment

gates.title: Types Exported
gates.description: Every Zod schema has a corresponding exported TypeScript type via z.infer<>

gates.title: No TODOs
gates.description: No TODO/FIXME/HACK/PLACEHOLDER in schema or types files

gates.title: Exhaustive Unions
gates.description: Discriminated object unions use z.discriminatedUnion(), not z.union() with overlapping objects

gates.title: Refinements Documented
gates.description: Every .refine() or .superRefine() call has a descriptive error message (no empty strings)

gates.title: Field Coverage
gates.description: All fields in schema-spec.json have a corresponding Zod definition in schema.ts. No field is declared but not implemented.

gates.title: OpenAPI Compatible
gates.description: openapi-schema.json is valid JSON Schema (draft-07 or OAS3) — no custom Zod transforms that break serialization

gates.title: No Circular Deps
gates.description: No circular schema references (A references B which references A)

gates.title: Schema Contract
gates.description: Schema matches schema.contract.json rules: naming, export structure, no raw objects

contracts.description: Structural rules for all compiled TypeScript schemas

error_codes.SC002: schema.ts missing Zod import or invalid structure
error_codes.SC004: Schema exported without corresponding TypeScript type
error_codes.SC006: Discriminated union uses z.union() instead of z.discriminatedUnion()
error_codes.SC007: .refine() has empty or missing error message
error_codes.SC008: Schema spec declares fields not implemented in schema.ts
error_codes.SC010: OpenAPI JSON Schema invalid or has non-serializable transforms
